Subject: Discovery recap + suggested next steps

Hi Sara — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from today
- Primary use case: real-time fraud chatter analysis across customer support transcripts (high token volume, priority on 99th percentile latency).
- Success metrics: sub-250ms p99 for short prompts, 40% token cost reduction vs current baseline via batching/caching.
- Current constraints: procurement timeline, SOC 2 evidence, and a requirement to avoid sending PII to third parties.

What Redwood can do for FinTech Plus (short):
- Hosted inference with optional private VPC and KMS integration (fits compliance ask).
- Prefab batch/caching profile that typically drops token spend ~35–45% for similar workloads.
- Can pin model version for predictable outputs and use canary rollout during integration.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan attached)
1) I’ll share the MVP pricing + MAP (attached).
2) Your team confirms priority and target decision date for budget/approvals (procurement details welcome).
3) Technical sync with your infra owner (30–45m) to validate VPC/KMS fit — target week of July 7 if still prioritized.

Attachments: Redwood_MVP_pricing_v2.pdf (pricing + usage examples), Mutual_Action_Plan_FinTechPlus.xlsx

Can you confirm: is this still on-track to be prioritized before end of July? If priorities shifted, tell me the new target and we’ll adjust recommendations.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it helps.

Best,
Jordan Blake
